items.title: Two Timescales of Forgetting in Fine-tuning of Language Models: Fast Behavioral Suppression and Slow Representational Drift
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2611.33302v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Today, a core pipeline of artificial intelligence systems is pretraining on a broad range of text corpora and then fine-tuning on specific tasks or desired behaviors. Yet we still have limited understanding of how fine-tuning on a restricted data distribution modifies representations acquired during pretraining. In particular, it remains unclear whether surface behavioral suppression happens together with the erasure of latent representations that support it. In this work, we study supervised fine-tuning (SFT) by pretraining transformers on a controlled context-free grammar with hierarchical latent structure, the Random Hierarchy Model (RHM), and fine-tuning with a restricted subset of its generative rules. items.reason_zh: 揭示微调中遗忘的两个时间尺度——快速行为抑制与缓慢表征漂移，对理解微调副作用有重要启发。
items.summary_zh: 论文研究预训练后微调如何改变模型在预训练阶段习得的表征。作者发现微调中的遗忘存在两个不同时间尺度：行为层面的抑制发生得很快，模型输出迅速转向目标任务；而表征层面的漂移则缓慢得多，预训练表征在较长时间内逐步偏移。这一区分说明仅看行为指标会低估微调对内部表征的影响。工作为理解微调副作用、灾难性遗忘与模型编辑提供了新的分析视角与实证证据。

items.title: 污染 0.1% 的预训练数据，就能给 AI 智能体埋下洗不掉的后门
items.raw_text: 只污染 0.1% 的预训练数据，就能给一个 AI 智能体埋下后门。而且用完全干净的数据做微调和强化学习，也清不掉。 这是一篇论文的结论，标题叫《Agentic Backdoors via Pretraining Poisoning》，作者来自加州大学伯克利分校、伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校和 Anthropic，其中包括 Nicholas Carlini 和 Javier Rando。论文 ...
items.reason_zh: 伯克利、UIUC与Anthropic合作论文揭示仅污染0.1%预训练数据即可植入难清除的智能体后门，安全启示强。
items.summary_zh: 文章介绍论文《Agentic Backdoors via Pretraining Poisoning》，作者来自加州大学伯克利分校、伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校和Anthropic，包括Nicholas Carlini与Javier Rando。研究结论是：只需污染0.1%的预训练数据，就能给AI智能体埋下后门，而且即便后续用完全干净的数据进行微调和强化学习，也无法清除该后门。这一发现揭示了预训练阶段数据投毒的长期隐蔽风险，对智能体安全、数据供应链治理与模型对齐研究都具有重要警示意义。
items.title_zh: 污染0.1%的预训练数据，就能给AI智能体埋下洗不掉的后门

items.title: When Are Parallel Subagents Effective for Coding? An Empirical Study on Repository Construction
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2611.33893v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: LLM-based coding agents are increasingly used for long-horizon tasks such as building an entire program from a specification. Products like Codex and Claude Code let an agent delegate work to parallel subagents, multiplying run cost, yet it remains unclear whether and when delegation produces a better program. We compare a single agent with a main agent delegating to subagents on repository-construction tasks from NL2Repo and ProgramBench (which also provides an executable reference program). We compare scores at equal time and equal cost, run intervention experiments, and analyze fine-grained behavior. On randomly drawn tasks, parallel subagents raise hidden-test pass rates by only about 1 to 5 percentage points at up to 3.8x the cost of a single agent. Their gain is larger on hard tasks, where we find evidence of three mechanisms. Self-checking: with GPT-5.6 Sol, one sentence telling a single agent to probe the reference program first
items.reason_zh: 实证回答并行子智能体何时真能提升编码质量，对使用 Codex、Claude Code 的工程团队有直接参考价值。
items.summary_zh: 论文针对 Codex、Claude Code 等产品支持的并行子智能体委派机制做实证研究：主智能体把任务分派给多个并行子智能体，会成倍增加运行成本，但委派是否、以及在什么条件下能产出更好的程序仍不清楚。作者在从规格说明构建完整仓库的长程编码任务上，对比单智能体与主从多智能体配置，分析任务可分解性、子任务耦合度等因素对最终代码质量的影响，给出何时值得使用并行委派的经验结论。
items.title_zh: 并行子智能体何时对编码有效？面向仓库构建的实证研究

items.title: What Must LLM Agents Communicate? From Information Loss to Communication Failures
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2611.33318v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: When evidence is distributed across LLM agents, a team may collectively possess all the information needed for a decision yet fail to use it effectively. What must agents communicate for accurate joint predictions, and when does interaction help? We study three requirements for effective communication: sufficiency of the information conveyed, selection of relevant evidence, and utilization of received information. Drawing on information theory and communication complexity, we develop a framework that combines theoretical benchmarks with controlled experiments and message-level analyses. We find that local probability reports can discard essential information, with theoretical information loss closely matching observed performance penalties. Query-first interaction improves predictions when relevant evidence depends on a private query, but compact one-shot representations can eliminate this advantage. items.summary_zh: 论文研究当证据分散在多个 LLM 智能体之间时，团队为何明明集体掌握全部信息却仍无法做出准确联合预测。作者提出有效通信的三个要求：所传递信息的充分性、信息的选择性以及通信失败的影响，并系统分析交互在什么条件下真正带来增益。研究把信息丢失与通信失败联系起来，给出智能体之间"必须沟通什么"的理论刻画，为多智能体协作协议的设计与诊断提供依据。

items.title: Rex：AI Agent 时代，为什么我们需要重新思考 Terminal Multiplexer？
items.raw_text: AI Agent 正在让终端从单人交互界面演变为多进程、多 Agent 协同运行环境。传统 Terminal Multiplexer 的价值因此被重新放大。本文从 Superlogical 的 Rex 出发，分析 tmux 的 Compositing 与 Rex 的 Mirroring 两种架构，介绍 libghostty、Server/Client、Block API 和 OSC 7501 等关键设计，并讨论 Rex 与 Herdr、Orca 的产品定位差异。Rex 最值得关注的地方，可能不是它现在拥有多少功能，而是它试图把 Terminal Multiplexer 建设成 AI Agent 时代的一种基础设施原语。
items.reason_zh: 从 Agent 多进程协同视角剖析终端复用器架构取舍，对做 Agent 基础设施的工程师有迁移价值。
items.summary_zh: 文章指出 AI Agent 正让终端从单人交互界面演变为多进程、多 Agent 协同的运行环境，传统 Terminal Multiplexer 的价值因此被重新放大。作者以 Superlogical 的 Rex 为例，对比 tmux 的 Compositing 架构与 Rex 的 Mirroring 架构，介绍 libghostty、Server/Client 模式、Block API 和 OSC 7501 等关键设计，并讨论 Rex 与 Herdr、Orca 的产品定位差异。文章认为 Rex 的意义不在于现有功能多少，而在于尝试把终端复用器做成 Agent 时代的基础设施原语。

items.title: Microsoft details how state-backed hackers use the ARTEX AI framework to automate cyberattacks
items.raw_text:
Microsoft has published the technical architecture of ARTEX, an AI framework in wide use since July 2026 that runs cyberattacks with specialized agents and almost no human involvement. State-backed groups from China and North Korea, along with criminal organizations, are already using the system. Microsoft recommends deception techniques like honeypots and faked success signals as defenses, but how long those will hold up against agents that learn and adapt remains an open question.

items.title: PLAICraft: Large-Scale Time-Aligned Vision-Speech-Action Dataset for Embodied AI
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2505.12707v3 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Advances in deep generative modeling have made it increasingly plausible to train human-level embodied agents. Yet progress has been limited by the absence of large-scale, real-time, multi-modal, and socially interactive datasets that reflect the sensory-motor complexity of natural environments. To address this, we present PLAICraft, a novel data collection platform and dataset capturing multiplayer Minecraft interactions across five time-aligned modalities: video, game output audio, microphone input audio, mouse, and keyboard actions. Each modality is logged with millisecond time precision, enabling the study of synchronous, embodied behaviour in a rich, open-ended world. The dataset comprises 5525 hours of interactive gameplay from more than 232 participants.
